sections.Profile:
The "Hi Straight" pinball machine, produced by J.H. Keeney & Co. in December 1959, is a single-player electro-mechanical game with a poker theme. The playfield features two flippers, five pop bumpers, two slingshots, and a gobble hole, providing an engaging gameplay experience.

- Manufacturer: Keeney and Sons
- Years made: 1960
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Poker, Wood Rail, Card games, Original Theme
